verdict.rationale: Jan documents importing local GGUF model files and runs inference through llama.cpp. GGUF is a quantized model format, which gives thin, indirect support for loading quantized models. Nothing in the evidence mentions quantization levels, and the specifically named formats (FP8, INT4, GPTQ, AWQ) are never referenced. Missing for 10: documented support for GPTQ, AWQ, FP8 or explicit INT4 quantization, explicit quantization-format documentation, and hands-on corroboration.
